changelog:
Initial release of ink-tui: React-based toolkit for terminal UIs.

- Provides React components (`Box`, `Text`, `Newline`, `Spacer`) for building interactive terminal apps with Flexbox/Yoga layout.
- Supports keyboard input, focus, and app control via hooks (`useInput`, `useApp`, `useFocus`, `useStdin`, `useStdout`).
- Includes examples for menus, spinners, progress bars, and input fields.
- Requires Node.js 22+ (ESM-only) and React 19.2+ as peer dependencies.
- Documents key constraints: terminal-only, Yoga-based layout, color/style support per terminal.
- Bundles detailed references for components, hooks, and runnable examples.
display_name: Ink — React for interactive command-line apps.
summary: Ink — React for interactive command-line apps. Build rich terminal UIs with React components.
